messages:
Devon (KitePay): Hey @Maria, KitePay is seeing 403 errors for embeddings and generation after our SSO provisioning run last night. Workflow that queries vector DB fails on production only. Ticket CS-4721. Any quick triage?
Maria (CS): Sorry to hear that — can you paste the curl you ran and the exact error body? Also which tenant/org id?
Devon (KitePay): tenant_id=kitepay-prod. Repro curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":"test"}'
```
Response (401/403 area):
```json
{
  "error": "missing_entitlement",
  "message": "token missing required entitlements: inference:generate, rerank:use",
  "required": ["inference:generate","rerank:use"]
}
```
Maria (CS): Hmm ok. Did the key come from your SSO-provisioned service account or was this a user-created key?
Devon (KitePay): It was auto-provisioned via our SCIM flow into the new service account. We did a full sync at 02:14 UTC. Nothing changed in app code. Embeddings used to work.
Maria (CS): On it — I'm going to try to repro with a repro key; assigning to @Oliver for eng triage if it's an entitlement mapping issue.
Oliver (Eng): Thanks. @Devon can you paste the token payload (redacted) or the decoded claims? e.g. header.payload.signature — you can redact signature or paste `jwt.split('.')` first 2 parts.
Devon (KitePay): pasted redacted token in thread (first 2 parts): eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzZXJ2aWNlX2FjYyIsImVudGl0bGVtZW50cyI6WyJlbWJlZGRpbmdzOnJlYWQiXSwibGV2ZWwiOiJwcm9kIn0
Maria (CS): Thanks. I decoded locally — claims show: `entitlements: ["embeddings:read"]` — indeed no `inference:generate` or `rerank:use`. That explains the 403 for generation endpoints.
Oliver (Eng): Interesting. Provisioning-bot, can you confirm what SCIM attribute was mapped to token entitlements in last sync?
provisioning-bot: SCIM sync id=2026-03-17T02:14Z applied mapping set v2.1. Mapped attr: `scoped_entitlements` -> token.claims.entitlements. No errors recorded.
Jay (SRE): Quick hypothesis: earlier we changed the SCIM payload key from `scopes` to `scoped_entitlements` to support nested arrays — some downstream claim parser still expects `scopes`. If provisioning wrote `scoped_entitlements` but the token minting service only looks for `scopes`, the inference grants would be dropped.
Oliver (Eng): Good call. Maria — can the customer create a temporary personal API key from account settings and test? That bypasses SSO/SCIM path and should have full inference entitlements if manually created.
Devon (KitePay): I can do that, but prod CI uses the service account, so we need permanent fix. But trying temp key now...
Devon (KitePay): Temp key worked — embeddings+generation both succeed. So backend gating is definitely entitlement-based.
Maria (CS): Ok, escalation plan: 1) Workaround: customer to use a manually-created org key while we fix parsing (confirmed working). 2) Eng to triage SCIM->minting pipeline and accept both `scoped_entitlements` and legacy `scopes` keys for a short-term hotfix. 3) Provisioning team to re-run sync for kitepay-prod after fix.
Oliver (Eng): I'll own the hotfix. Likely change: token-minting service update to accept either `scopes` or `scoped_entitlements` and merge arrays. I'll open ENG-1198 and target a hotfix deploy in the next deploy window.
Jay (SRE): Heads-up: if we broaden parsing, add tests so we don't accidentally allow malformed strings (e.g., a single CSV string). Patch should normalize to an array of `scope:action` pairs.
Maria (CS): I've informed Devon and updated ticket CS-4721 with the workaround and that ENG owns the fix (ENG-1198). Devon — can you re-run the SCIM sync after we announce the fix? We'll coordinate a short maintenance window.
Devon (KitePay): Yep I can coordinate. Please ping when fix merges. Appreciate the fast turnaround :thumbsup:
Oliver (Eng): Will post PR link and ETA in this thread. Expected hotfix in ~3 hours, deploy after smoke tests.
provisioning-bot: ENG-1198 created by Oliver. CI run started.
Maria (CS): Marking customer as impacted -> high, notifying AM. I'll update CS-4721 with the mitigation steps.
Oliver (Eng): PR merged and CI green. Deploy started to staging. I'll post when in prod.
provisioning-bot: Deploy to prod scheduled in 2h.
Jay (SRE): After deploy, we should re-run SCIM for kitepay-prod and verify tokens now include `inference:generate` and `rerank:use`. Maria/Devon — I can help coordinate the re-sync.
Devon (KitePay): Re-sync confirmed after deploy, tokens now have expected entitlements. Production jobs green. Thanks all!
Maria (CS): Closing loop — workaround used, fix deployed, postmortem owner assigned to Oliver for follow-up diagnostics and adding regression tests. Closing CS-4721 after customer sign-off. :white_check_mark:
